target: Post-merge acceptance-readiness evidence for ADR-SB-001..010, executed after the machine-contract evidence merged to main as 75b4cfc581786a53445e412bfc8e25a6e0fdb978. Verifies the merged contract family from clean main, runs a fresh MA-08 drift recheck from discovery base 72af781e42 through that SHA, obtains a fresh independent acceptance-integrity audit bound to it, and prepares a fresh ten-ADR disposition worksheet for the operator. Records no disposition, accepts no ADR, and authorizes no implementation. Read-only with respect to Second Brain architecture and runtime.
invariants: RISK_LANE=L2. Evidence and readiness only; no architecture or runtime change.

MA08_MAIN_SHA=75b4cfc581786a53445e412bfc8e25a6e0fdb978 governs every artifact in this packet. It was resolved from a fresh fetch at execution time and matches the operator-stated contract-evidence merge commit.
ADR_ACCEPTANCE_AUTHORIZED=false. No ADR disposition is recorded by this packet. Dispositions are OPERATOR_ONLY and every worksheet disposition field reads PENDING_OPERATOR.
PRIOR_OPERATOR_DISPOSITIONS=10x DEFER, a single blanket operator directive covering ADR-SB-001..010, not a per-ADR ledger. It remains the current disposition until the operator replaces it.

The 10x ACCEPT ledger at unpushed commit 19fa74faa9 is SUPERSEDED_PRE_AMENDMENT_ACCEPTANCE_ATTEMPT with operator_provenance UNKNOWN. It is not the prior disposition state, is not inherited, copied, or inferred, and is not touched by this packet.
DENIAL_FIXTURES=NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Implementing them is forbidden by this packet; they remain an implementation-time enablement gate under the amended AC#2.

CANDIDATE_SHA256=e4b28946156096319557fd25e0289c5de4b593b6239cc5c7af9b3efed259b66c and RATIFICATION_BINDING_SHA256=a23efdc676c499cc56b76c5fe321acd0bcf60871be18a33c7539e2350ba07b34 are frozen authority. This packet reads them and modifies neither.

Second Brain authority records, the candidate document, the traceability matrix, the FO-01 receipt, the machine contracts, the validator, and the adversarial suite are all READ-ONLY to this packet. It writes only under proof/TP-DMX-SECOND-BRAIN-ADR-ACCEPTANCE-002/** plus this packet file.
Nothing is written into proof/TP-DMX-SECOND-BRAIN-ADR-ACCEPTANCE-001/**. That is a prior run's bundle bound to head cfa4927a88 and writing into it would edit controlling historical evidence.
Only MA-08 result NO_NEW_MATERIAL_DRIFT may advance the phase. A material authority or privacy change in the window stops the phase as BLOCKED_NEW_MATERIAL_DRIFT.
The required audit outcome string is the gate to advance, not an instruction to the auditor. A FAIL verdict is recorded verbatim and stops the phase.
The audit must not infer runtime behaviour from architecture-time artifacts.
Any Grok audit must pin -m grok-4.5 explicitly. The grok CLI default moved to grok-4.6, which the trusted embedded-audit contract does not admit.
Terminal state is READY_FOR_OPERATOR_ADR_REDISPOSITION / AWAITING_OPERATOR_ADR_DISPOSITIONS. No work continues past it without new operator instruction.

steps.task: Resolve the actual current origin/main at execution time and pin it as MA08_MAIN_SHA.
requirements: origin/main is read from a fresh fetch, not a cached ref.
The resolved SHA is recorded and every downstream artifact binds to it.
Source custody hashes are computed at that SHA and compared against the prior run's recorded values, with every difference explained by a merged operator-authorized change.

shasum -a 256 <second brain authority, candidate, traceability, FO-01 receipt, inventory, coverage, validator>
validation: origin/main is read from a fresh fetch and recorded verbatim.
Every custody sha256 difference against the prior run's record is explained by a merged, operator-authorized change.

requirements: Validator exit 0 with result PASS_SECOND_BRAIN_ADR_MACHINE_CONTRACT_COVERAGE.

steps.task: Run a fresh MA-08 drift recheck from discovery base 72af781e42 through MA08_MAIN_SHA.
requirements: No prior MA-08 result is inherited; previously adjudicated segments are re-reviewed.
The new segment's file classification is complete: class counts must sum to the segment's file count.
Runtime, schema, and service file counts are enumerated rather than asserted as zero.
The §11 hard-gate checklist is evaluated over the full window, not the new segment alone.
Result is exactly one of NO_NEW_MATERIAL_DRIFT or BLOCKED_NEW_MATERIAL_DRIFT.
validation: Segment commit counts sum to the window commit count.
Segment C class counts sum to the segment file count.
Runtime, schema, and service file counts are enumerated by name rather than asserted as zero.
Result is exactly NO_NEW_MATERIAL_DRIFT or BLOCKED_NEW_MATERIAL_DRIFT.

steps.task: Freeze the packet content head, then generate the audit prompt against the frozen head.
requirements: The prompt is authored after the freeze so it names the head it audits; a prompt naming a dead head is a defect this series has already paid for.
The prompt proves that the frozen head differs from MA08_MAIN_SHA only in this packet's own proof and task-packet paths.
The prompt carries the operator's must-not-infer-runtime-behaviour constraint verbatim and requires explicit BLOCKERS and MUST_FIX counts.
validation: git diff --cached --check is clean.
The diff from MA08_MAIN_SHA to the frozen head contains only this packet's proof paths and its task packet.
The prompt is authored after the freeze and names the head it audits.

steps.task: Run a fresh independent post-merge acceptance-integrity audit bound to the frozen head.
requirements: The auditor runs in a throwaway detached worktree pinned to the frozen head with no producer conversation history.
The auditor reviews the ten ADRs, the 160-clause denominator, the typed contracts, FO-01 reconciled state, current traceability, and the fresh MA-08 result.
Any Grok invocation pins -m grok-4.5 explicitly.
The verdict is recorded verbatim including a FAIL. A FAIL stops the phase.
validation: The auditor runs in a throwaway detached worktree pinned to the audited head.
Any Grok invocation pins -m grok-4.5, verified afterwards from the runner's own per-turn session record.
The verdict is recorded verbatim, including a FAIL or a remaining must-fix.
The phase advances only on BLOCKERS 0 and MUST_FIX 0.

steps.task: Prepare the fresh ten-ADR disposition worksheet and stop.
requirements: Each ADR carries its machine contracts, parse/coverage result, MA-08 result, audit result, remaining implementation-time requirements, and a fresh facilitator recommendation.
Recommendations are stated in a field separate from the disposition field, and every disposition field reads PENDING_OPERATOR.
The prior 10x DEFER is stated as still current and is not mechanically inherited as the recommendation.
Terminal state is READY_FOR_OPERATOR_ADR_REDISPOSITION / AWAITING_OPERATOR_ADR_DISPOSITIONS.
